description: Listed at Air Force Headquarters, Pretoria in both the 2013 forum gate-guard inventory and the current Unofficial SAAF Website list. Current Esri World Imagery shows one plinth-mounted airframe with a swept planform at the south-west corner of the SAAF HQ block on Dequar Road, Salvokop. That sighting confirms at least one airframe is still standing, but the resolution does not distinguish a Mirage F1 from an Impala, and only one airframe was found where the list records two.
museum_name: SA Air Force Headquarters Aircraft Display

description: Ex-Silver Falcons display-team aircraft, flown as team numbers 1, 3 and 4. Listed at Air Force Headquarters, Pretoria in both the 2013 forum inventory and the current SAAF list, and photographed there on 22 September 2018. A 2013 forum contributor recorded that it originally wore the orange white and blue Silver Falcons scheme but had by then been repainted all-silver, so its paint is not evidence of team identity. Only one airframe was found at the HQ site on current satellite imagery, so it is unresolved whether this Impala or Mirage F1CZ 202 is the survivor.
